setup: The difference quotient \(\frac{f([[x0]]+h) - f([[x0]])}{h}\) is the slope of the secant through \(x = [[x0]]\) and \(x = [[x0]] + h\) on \(f(x) = x^{2}\).

steps.say: Divide by \(h = [[h]]\): \([[diff]] / [[h]] = [[answer]]\). In general \(\frac{([[x0]]+h)^{2} - [[x0]]^{2}}{h} = [[two_x0]] + h\), which at \(h = [[h]]\) is the same [[answer]].
